program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
    (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
      (if (= (length cells) 2)
          (let ((a (first cells)) (b (second cells)))
            (cond [(= (first a) (first b))
                   (paint-cells out
                     (for/list ([c (in-range (min (second a) (second b))
                                             (+ (max (second a) (second b)) 1))])
                       (list (first a) c))
                     color)]
                  [(= (second a) (second b))
                   (paint-cells out
                     (for/list ([r (in-range (min (first a) (first b))
                                             (+ (max (first a) (first b)) 1))])
                       (list r (second a)))
                     color)]
                  [else out]))
          out))))
